sources.label: Custom Morphe patches by heval99
sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Removes all ads and the "ads or Pro" dialog.
Disables analytics, crash reporting and sale promo notifications.

sources.label: o0b
sources.author: o0b
patch_list: Disables Firebase completely (init provider, analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config wiring, install UUID), turns off the sale promo push notifications, and prevents Fyber's crash handler from installing at process start.
Unlocks Business Calendar 2 Pro by forcing the complete pro status and the force-pro override to return true, routing every feature gate to the full package (7) without touching billing.
